claim: Items can be returned for a refund within 30 days of delivery.
A valid order ID is required to process any refund.
Items purchased during a clearance sale are not eligible for refund, only exchange.
Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Standard domestic shipping costs 99 rupees per order.
Orders above 999 rupees qualify for free standard shipping.
Standard domestic delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
International shipping is not currently available.
Electronics products carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty against defects.
Warranty does not cover damage caused by accidental drops or water exposure.
Orders can be cancelled free of charge only before they have shipped.
Once an order has shipped, it cannot be cancelled and must go through the return process instead.
Only one discount code can be applied per order.
Discount codes not listed as active in the current promotions list are invalid and must not be honored.
